:::{#exm-sd}
#### Precision and standard deviation of a fair coin flip

In @exm-variance-bernoulli, a fair coin flip has $\Var{X} = 1/4$,
so its precision is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\precision(X) &= 1 / (1/4) \\
&= 4
\end{aligned}
$$

and its standard deviation is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\SD{X} &= \sqrt{1/4} \\
&= 1/2.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
